name: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund
positioning: Riverside urban retreat on the bank of the Huangpu River in Shanghai, where every room and suite looks over the river and skyline
best_for: Travelers who want river and skyline views from their room
Couples looking for a room with a private dipping pool or a deep soaking tub

facts.text: The hotel lies on the bank of the Huangpu River in Shanghai.
The Grand Bund Suite has a deep round soaking tub in a modern bathroom.
The Grand Riverside Suite has a king-size bed with an extensive Pillow Menu.
The Junior Riverside Suite has large glass windows facing the river and a chaise longue to enjoy the view.
The hotel has an indoor pool and three relaxation pools.
The fitness club includes a Yoga Studio and a fitness centre.
Spa treatments draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian and Indonesian traditions.
TALES is a rooftop bar on the banks of the Huangpu River.
Prince Kitchen is a Cantonese restaurant with signature abalone dishes by Master Chef Mai Guangfan.
Curated experiences range from riverside afternoon tea and bespoke spa treatments to cultural workshops.
Lujiazui Financial District is about 10 minutes from the hotel by taxi.

highlights.text: All rooms and suites have views of the Huangpu River and the skyline.
The Bund Oasis with Romantic Pool room has a private dipping pool.
The spa spans three floors and has an indoor pool.
The Banyan Suite has panoramic views of the Huangpu River, the Bund and the city skyline, with personal host service.
Guests can enjoy a Full Moon Destination Dining experience or a traditional Sundown Ritual at TALES.

considerations.text: The Bund itself is about 10 minutes from the hotel by taxi.
Pudong International Airport is approximately 45 minutes away by car.
Under a Shanghai regulation, eleven disposable items such as toothbrushes are not proactively provided in guestrooms but are available on request.
